questions.q: According to Peter's opening blessing, God caused believers to be born again to what?
Peter says believers were redeemed not with silver or gold, but with what?
options: Precious blood, as of a spotless lamb

questions.q: Which region is NOT named among the places Peter's readers are living?
What does Peter say angels desire to do?
The grass withers, and its flower falls; but ____.
The proof of your faith, which is more precious than ____, is tested by fire.
Having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through ____.

items: Born again to a living hope
Faith tested by fire like gold
The prophets searched about this salvation
Redeemed with the blood of a spotless lamb

questions.q: Peter tells his readers that they love and rejoice in Jesus even though they do not see him now.
Peter says it was revealed to the prophets that they were serving themselves in what they foretold.
Like newborn babies, what does Peter tell believers to long for?
What does Peter call Jesus, rejected by men but chosen by God?
According to the Scripture Peter quotes, what was not found in Christ's mouth?
Peter says his readers were once going astray like what?
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, ____, a people for God's own possession.
Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for ____, but as bondservants of God.
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. ____. Honor the king.

items: Put away all wickedness and deceit
Come to him, a living stone
Subject yourselves to every ordinance of man
Servants, be in subjection to your masters

questions.q: Peter tells servants to be subject only to masters who are good and gentle.
Peter says governors are sent for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
Where does Peter say a wife's beauty should come from?
options: The hidden person of the heart
Her good works in the church

questions.q: What did Sarah call Abraham, as Peter describes her?
Peter tells husbands to honor their wives for what stated purpose?
options: That their prayers may not be hindered
That their homes may be at peace
That their children may obey them
That they may live long on earth

questions.q: How many souls does Peter say were saved through water in Noah's ship?
Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning ____.
questions.answer: the hope that is in you

questions.q: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him ____.
The incorruptible adornment of ____, which is very precious in God's sight.

items: Wives, be in subjection to your own husbands
Husbands, live with your wives according to knowledge
All of you be like minded and compassionate
Christ preached to the spirits in prison

questions.q: Peter says that if you suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed.
Peter says baptism saves by putting away the filth of the flesh.
What does Peter say love covers?
What does Peter say about the end of all things?
options: It will come like a thief

questions.q: What does Peter tell believers to be toward one another without grumbling?
Which of these is NOT in Peter's list of ways a believer should not suffer?
options: As a meddler in other men's matters

questions.q: Beloved, don't be astonished at ____ which has come upon you to test you.
If anyone speaks, let it be as it were ____.
For the time has come for judgment to begin with ____.
wrong: the enemies of the Good News

items: Arm yourselves with the same mind as Christ
A past life of lewdness and drunken binges
Employ each gift in serving one another
Entrust your souls to a faithful Creator

questions.q: Peter says a believer who suffers for being a Christian should not be ashamed.
Peter says the Gentiles speak well of believers who no longer run with them into excess.
What does Peter compare the devil to?
What will faithful elders receive when the chief Shepherd is revealed?
options: The crown of glory that doesn't fade
A seat at his right hand

questions.q: How does Peter describe himself when he addresses the elders?
options: A fellow elder and witness of Christ's sufferings
The chief shepherd of the churches

questions.q: Through whom does Peter say he has written this letter?
Casting all your worries on him, because ____.
God resists the proud, but ____.
wrong: hears the cry of the poor

questions.q: Greet one another with ____. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus.

items: Exhort the elders to shepherd the flock
Younger ones, be subject to the elder
Withstand him steadfast in your faith
She who is in Babylon greets you

questions.q: Peter tells elders to lead by lording it over those entrusted to them.
Peter says believers' brothers in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
